summary: 3–6 month research internship at KAUST in Saudi Arabia, with a stipend, housing and travel.
eligibility: 3rd/4th-year bachelor's and master's STEM students from any country.
title: KAUST Visiting Student Research Program (VSRP)

prize.description: About $1,000 per month, private housing and travel, as reported.

notes: Rolling applications, no fixed deadline; a recommendation letter, SOP and CV are needed.
